title: .respawnpack/runtime/rollover/<host>-<conversationId>/memory/<id>.json — a candidate memory
description: Written by core/memory/candidates.js. ⛔ A CANDIDATE IS NOT A FACT. `verificationState` is the wall: only a `verified` record may be promoted to canonical project memory, promotion requires at least one supporting evidence path, and a `candidate` may only ever be recalled as an unverified lead. The record is REWRITTEN as its state changes and the append-only audit.jsonl beside it is the authority for how it got there — the opposite trade from the rollover handoff, whose bytes are the evidence and which is therefore never rewritten. GITIGNORED, machine-local, and NOT registered in schemas/registry.json: registration happens in W5 with the savepoint writer.

claim.description: The assertion, as captured. A memory with no assertion asserts nothing and cannot be checked.

klass.description: Only these four may ever become canonical. Anything else is a note, and notes do not become project truth.

cycleId.description: WHICH CONTEXT CYCLE produced it. Required: a memory outlives the cycle that made it, and one that cannot name that cycle cannot be audited against what was known then.

evidencePaths.description: Paths, never conclusions. An empty array is a real answer and is exactly what blocks promotion.

previousState.description: A VERIFIED memory may be rejected later; findings are overturned. The prior state is kept so the audit shows what was believed and for how long.
